CAMPAIGN_BUILDER.FIX_STEP_DESCRIPTION: Taken to the step that needs attention.
CAMPAIGN_BUILDER_PROGRESS.LABEL: Discount creation progress
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.CAMPAIGN_END: A campaign needs an end date.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.CAMPAIGN_END_BEFORE_START: The campaign cannot end before it starts.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.CAMPAIGN_NEEDS_PRICE: This campaign kind needs at least one price named — it prices a specific price's opening period or first annual period, not a plan in general.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.CAMPAIGN_START: A campaign needs a start date.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.CAMPAIGN_TIME_ZONE: A campaign needs a time zone its dates are read in.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.CODE_PATTERN: Code may only contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.DURATION_WHOLE: Number of discounted billing periods must be a whole number greater than zero.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.ENTITLEMENT_LIMIT_POSITIV: The temporary entitlement limit must be a positive number.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.EXPIRE_AFTER_START: The discount must expire after it starts.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.EXPIRY_INVALID: Enter a valid expiry date and time.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.FREE_MUST_BE_FULL: A free-opening-period campaign must be a full 100% reduction.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.FREE_NEEDS_ENTITLEMENT: A free-opening-period campaign must name the entitlement it temporarily caps.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.FREE_NOT_FIXED: A free-opening-period campaign cannot be a fixed amount — it must be 100% off.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.METER_NOT_SOLD: No plan this code applies to sells credits for the meter '{{meter}}'.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.PERCENT_RANGE: Percent off must be between 0 and 100.
CAMPAIGN_DRAFT.START_INVALID: Enter a valid start date and time.
STEP_BENEFIT.DESCRIPTION: What redeeming this discount takes off.
STEP_BENEFIT.DURATION_HINT: Example: 3 applies the discount to the next three charges. Leave empty for no period limit.
STEP_BENEFIT.EXPIRES_AT_HINT: The code is unavailable at and after this instant.
STEP_BENEFIT.FREE_MONTH_NOTE: A free opening month is always a full 100% reduction — nothing to set here.
STEP_BENEFIT.PRECEDENCE_BEST_DESCRIPTION: Whichever reduction is larger — this campaign's, or the price's own — never both.
STEP_BENEFIT.PRECEDENCE_LABEL: How it meets the price's own discount
STEP_BENEFIT.PRECEDENCE_LEGACY: This existing Standard discount keeps using each plan's discount-combination policy until you choose an option.
STEP_BENEFIT.PRECEDENCE_REPLACE_DESCRIPT: This campaign's reduction only, for as long as it applies — even if smaller.
STEP_BENEFIT.PRECEDENCE_STACK_DESCRIPTIO: Both reductions combined, capped at 100% of the price.
STEP_BENEFIT.SELF_EXPIRING: This offer expires itself — a first-year discount stops after the first annual period, automatically. There is no duration to set.
STEP_BENEFIT.STARTS_AT_HINT: Leave empty to make the code available immediately.
STEP_BENEFIT.TITLE: Benefit
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.DESCRIPTION: What this discount applies to, and the window it can be redeemed in.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.ENDS_HINT: Leave empty to keep the offer available until an administrator archives it.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.METERS_HINT: Limit the code to credits for these meters. Leave all unticked for any meter whose credits are on sale.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.METERS_NONE: No plan this code applies to sells credits yet.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.ONE_REDEMPTION_CREDIT_H: Each organization can use this code on one credit purchase.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.PLANS_CAMPAIGN_HINT: Only plans with a price this offer can actually price are listed.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.PLANS_HINT: Leave every box clear to allow any plan.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.PLANS_NONE_CAMPAIGN: No plan has a price this offer type can be redeemed against yet.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.PRICES_CAMPAIGN_HINT: This offer prices a specific price's opening period, not a plan in general — name at least one.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.PRICES_HINT: Narrows to one cadence or currency — a yearly-only offer, for instance.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.REQUIRES_PAYMENT_METHOD: Requires a payment method before activation
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.TEMP_ENTITLEMENT_HINT: The count entitlement this offer temporarily caps while the free month runs.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.TEMP_LIMIT_HINT: Cannot exceed the plan's own limit for this entitlement.
STEP_ELIGIBILITY.TITLE: Eligibility
STEP_IDENTITY.CODE_HINT: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores only. Fixed once created.
STEP_IDENTITY.DESCRIPTION: What this discount is called, and what kind of offer it is.
STEP_IDENTITY.KIND_FIRST_YEAR_DESCRIPTIO: Discounts a calendar-aligned yearly price's first full annual period only. A renewal past that reverts to the price's own rate automatically — no expiry date to manage.
STEP_IDENTITY.KIND_FREE_OPENING_DESCRIPT: 100% off a calendar-aligned monthly price's opening period only — signup to the next calendar-month boundary — paired with a temporary entitlement cap. One redemption per organization, and requires a card upfront.
STEP_IDENTITY.KIND_STANDARD_DESCRIPTION: An ordinary percentage or fixed reduction. No date window, no redemption limit.
STEP_IDENTITY.SCOPE_CREDITS_DESCRIPTION: Redeemed when buying extra meter credits. One purchase, so no duration.
STEP_IDENTITY.SCOPE_SUBSCRIPTIONS_DESCRI: Redeemed at signup and kept through plan changes.
STEP_IDENTITY.TITLE: Identity
STEP_REVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Check everything before creating this discount — the code cannot be changed afterward.
STEP_REVIEW.PRECEDENCE_LEGACY: Uses the plan's discount policy (legacy behavior)
STEP_REVIEW.SELF_EXPIRING: This offer expires and reverts to standard pricing on its own — there is nothing to schedule or remember to turn off.
STEP_REVIEW.TITLE: Review
